title: Little Mayor
description: Make a toy city around the house. Build little places and send your toy friends to work.
about: Remember when whatever was lying around the house and your toys were enough to build a city? Little Mayor is a city builder that takes place on a kid's bedroom floor. The whole city is built out of toys and whatever else is lying around the room, and your residents are peg dolls, toy soldiers, robots and more.
features: Build workshops and put your toy friends to work in them
Run production chains, from sugar and crayons up to candy, cupcakes and toy cars
Grant your friends' wishes at the town hall to grow the town
Research new buildings and buy more floor space
14 toy friends, each good at some jobs and bad at others
A clone station, if you want more of a friend you already like
